_comment: The seven skill groups. Each is a directory beside claude-skills with its skills under skills/. Agreed in docs/plans/2026-10-12-claude-skills-audit.md and its 18/11/2026 update. The disk decides which skills a group holds; this file only says where the groups are. public_repo is the group's public twin, and must match release.toml (tests/test_release.py checks it). Names agreed 24/11/2026 in docs/plans/2026-11-24-skill-group-repos.md.

groups.title: .NET skills
groups.summary: .NET, Blazor, Avalonia, Aspire and the Azure services .NET shops use.

groups.title: Language gurus
groups.summary: Current best practice for Python, TypeScript, Rust, Go, shell and PowerShell.

groups.title: Engineering practices
groups.summary: Language-neutral craft: TDD, KISS, design patterns, twelve-factor, root cause analysis and decision interviews.

groups.title: API skills
groups.summary: Working with REST APIs: GitHub, Microsoft Graph, Home Assistant, FreeAgent, AdGuard Home and Dokploy.

groups.title: AI engineering
groups.summary: Building with and around models: agent patterns, coding agent setup and sandboxing, fine-tuning data and project kickoff.

groups.title: Developer environment
groups.summary: Tooling around the code: mise, devcontainers, terminal multiplexers, git protection, hosting and markdown.

groups.title: GCSE tutors
groups.summary: Nine GCSE revision tutors, frozen at the 2026 exam year.
